name: Tankentai 2 - Makyou Amazon no Okuchi ni Kogane Densetsu o Mita!
original_name: 探検隊第二弾　魔境アマゾンの奥地に黄金伝説を見た！
source:
Game is a parody on famous Japanese geographical TV show. It is reported that gold is found on the Amazon river with the aim of raising TV rating and expedition is sent there alongside TV unit.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作恶搞了日本一档知名地理探险电视节目。节目宣称亚马孙河发现了黄金，并以提高收视率为目的，派出探险队和摄制组前往当地。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
